scope: Optional generated-program mechanism diagnostic, not a new evolution method or a framework comparison
hypothesis: The successful generated program benefits from permitting nonzero cell-label changes rather than restricting every output cell to its original label or zero.
single_intervention: One move-admission guard; input, feasibility checker, scoring, time limit, RNG initialization and rest of selected program unchanged. Manual variant must never be reported as an evolved selected candidate.
evaluation_not_yet_scheduled: If justified after current cohort: same150 public TRAIN cases, same compiler/time limit, repeat both variants on both original CPU slots. No model calls, held-out access or optimizer feedback. Keep primary campaign scores unchanged.
limitations: One selected development program, proposed after seeing its success. This can diagnose a move-set component; it cannot establish framework superiority or an unbiased population effect.
